must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Two-track page: after the hero the page forks into two parallel columns, 'For you' and 'For your team (info@, sales@)', running side by side to pricing.
layout.why: About half of paying customers are teams on their own domain; they get their own column instead of a footnote.

hero.idea: The real draft card, rendered from the shipping card build at 1:1, with To, Subject, body and Approve / Edit buttons, next to a left-aligned H1.
hero.why: Proves the strongest differentiator in the first second: nothing goes out without your yes.

visual_style.idea: Postmark separators: section breaks are circular postmarks in cobalt line work (date plus 'STOCKHOLM'), the only ornament on the page.
visual_style.why: One ownable ornament that also carries the data-location fact.

typography.idea: Archivo 800 at wdth 62 for poster-like headlines, Archivo 400 at wdth 100 body, same family for everything.
typography.why: Swiss-poster energy from one variable font.

narrative.idea: Velocity story: the product told through what shipped recently, with dated changelog entries as chapters.
narrative.why: Shows an active product without inventing numbers.

proof.idea: Changelog pace: the latest dated entries read from the public changelog at build time, linking to the full page.
proof.why: Real dates prove an active product.

asset_use.idea: Only one clip on the page, in the hero; every other asset is a still.
asset_use.why: Keeps the page calm and fast.

motion.idea: No motion at all: a static page with designed hover underlines and focus rings only.

section_order.idea: Hero > Day in the life (morning, noon, evening) > Approval > Teams > Pricing > FAQ > Recent changelog
section_order.why: Habit story with a living-product ending.

voice.idea: Modest and concrete. Sample: 'A small company, a real inbox for support, and nothing of yours on our disks.'
voice.why: No hype, just facts a buyer can check.

wildcard.idea: The page is a printed letter: letterhead, date, 'Dear reader,', a signature, and Start free as the P.S.
